description: Add recipients (email + optional name) to a campaign. Up to 50 per request, 200 per campaign. Duplicate addresses are ignored.
name: add_campaign_recipients

outputSchema.description: Counts after adding recipients. Duplicates within the request and addresses already on the campaign are skipped, so `added` can be lower than the number submitted.

added.description: Recipients newly inserted by this call.

total.description: Total recipients on the campaign afterwards (capped at 200).
